mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant WHERE del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant WHERE del_flag = 0 AND create_time < #{time}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant WHERE del_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{time}
SELECT create_time FROM sys_tenant WHERE del_flag = 0 AND create_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY create_time
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM edu_tenant_ext WHERE del_flag = 0 AND biz_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant t WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= NOW() AND t.end_date < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT t.name AS name, COALESCE(p.name, '未指定套餐') AS packageName, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expireTime, DATEDIFF(t.end_date, NOW()) AS daysLeft FROM sys_tenant t LEFT JOIN edu_tenant_ext e ON e.org_tenant_id = t.id AND e.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN edu_package p ON p.id = e.package_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= NOW() AND t.end_date < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY t.end_date ASC

SELECT apply_no AS applyNo, org_name AS orgName, org_type AS orgType, stages AS stages, contact AS contact, phone AS phone, submitted_at AS submittedAt FROM edu_tenant_apply WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY submitted_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
